segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר "שמירה בתוך המכנסיים" (שמירה אין דיא אוזין) היינו לענין המצות שמדקדקין שיהי' שמירה משעת קצירה כראוי ליראי ה' אמר רבינו ז"ל על זה שהעיקר שמירה הוא לשמור שבירת הברית היינו המוח מהרהורים רעים ומחשבות רעות שזה עיקר החמץ כמובא בספריו הק' ובלקוטי תפלות ובליקוטי הלכות שזה עיקר החמץ במשהו ה' ישמרנו מזה אכי"ר.
segments.en: I heard from Reb Chaim Zonnenfeld, of blessed memory, that Rabbainu — when he was still a small child studying with the elementary teacher — once wept. His father asked why, and Rabbainu answered: because the teacher had hit him. His father asked the teacher why he hit him. The teacher answered: because among the morning blessings Rabbainu had not recited the blessing Shelo Asani Goy [Who has not made me a gentile]. They asked Rabbainu why. He answered: because he had already said it — immediately after the handwashing [netilat yadayim]. They asked why immediately after netilat yadayim and not in its proper order. He replied: according to the Gemara, the order of the morning blessings follows the sequence of the actions performed. Since immediately upon rising one washes one's hands — therefore the blessing connected to this action must be first: Shelo Asani Goy, since a gentile does not wash his hands upon rising. "Di hershte brokhah iz: az s'iz nit kayn goy." This story I did not hear from our fellowship — and it also appears in the Parparaos LeChochmah by the Rav of Tcheryn, who told it as something people say in Rabbainu's name, adding that he himself had not heard it from our fellowship.
